attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (vtnet1/opt1, 10.50.1.254/24, peer node2 at 10.50.1.11) and lan-b (vtnet2/opt2, 10.50.2.254/24, peer node3 at 10.50.2.12). Blocked TCP/23 in both directions between the two networks with pf logging enabled, and demonstrated a refused-and-logged telnet attempt from node2 to node3. Completed the mandatory restart protocol for all 3 nodes: node1 and node2 were fully restarted with boot-identity change confirmed and full service/data recovery verified, including a repeat block+log demonstration after node1's restart. node3's restart was acknowledged and its baseline boot_id captured, but it remained unreachable (connection reset by peer / timed out) for over 30 minutes after the reboot command was issued, so its post-restart recovery could not be confirmed within the session. This is reported as a scoped limitation for that one node only; the core task and node1/node2 restart evidence are fully verified.
